courses.note: The Software Development concentration lists COP 3330C or COP 2805C. Search found FrontDoor syllabi for COP 3330C (one labeled Fall 2024, term 202410), but both URLs returned 404 when fetched, so nothing is recorded.

The BAS Software Development concentration requires no algorithms course and no systems course (computer organization or systems programming). Its required courses are COP 3330C or COP 2805C, CEN 3024C, CEN 4025C, CEN 4802C, CEN 4910C, CEN 4930C, plus electives.

courses.note: Elective. The Software Development concentration requires no operating systems or security course. CIS 3644 is the one security course in the BAS (listed as an elective in the Cloud Computing concentration, and open as an upper-division CIS elective for Software Development). No syllabus found; a 2024 FrontDoor syllabus exists for CET 4663 Computer and Network Security but that course is outside this concentration's elective list.

notes: Valencia has no bachelor's in computer science. The nearest equivalent is the upper-division BAS in Computing Technology and Software Development (60 credits after an AS or AA); its lower-division feeder is the AS in Computer Programming and Analysis, and an AS in STEM (Computer Science) also exists. The catalog page lists no algorithms or systems course, so C3 is null. Because the BAS is upper-division only, C1 comes from the common admission prerequisites. Valencia posts instructor syllabi on FrontDoor, but the retrieved links were dead (404); not-found means no fetchable syllabus text, not that none exists. Collected with web search and fetch only.
